name: error-empty-body-under-br
description: An empty body under br is refused, the same answer gzip and zstd give.

error.detail: the uniform empty-body rule (PCC-1134), inherited by a coding on the day it becomes supported

grounding: The empty-body rule exists precisely because it must not depend on which decoder the header named (PCC-1134), so a newly supported coding is pinned under it on arrival rather than left to drift.
